courses.title: SvelteTraining
courses.description: A complete home fitness program designed by certified trainers. Build strength, burn fat, and transform your body — no gym, no equipment required.

videos.title: Welcome to SvelteTraining
videos.description: Get a full overview of your 6-week transformation journey. Learn what to expect from each session, how to use the program effectively, and how to set yourself up for lasting success from day one.

videos.title: Your Body Assessment
videos.description: Understand your starting point with a guided body assessment. We walk through the key metrics that matter, help you identify areas to target, and establish a baseline so you can track your real progress.

videos.title: Beginner Home Workout Foundations
videos.description: Build the essential movement patterns that underpin every workout in this program. Perfect your form with fundamental bodyweight exercises before adding intensity — this session is the cornerstone of your results.

videos.title: Core & Strength Fundamentals
videos.description: Develop a rock-solid core and functional strength using minimal equipment. These targeted exercises form the backbone of your home training routine and directly support every other session in the program.

videos.title: HIIT & Cardio Training
videos.description: Push your cardiovascular limits with high-intensity interval sessions engineered to torch calories and build endurance — all from your living room. Short bursts, maximum results, zero equipment needed.

videos.title: Nutrition & Recovery Guide
videos.description: Fuel your results with a practical, no-fluff guide to eating for performance and recovery. Covers post-workout nutrition, smart hydration strategies, sleep optimization, and how to sustain your gains long-term.
